Presets keep the current image ratio and never enlarge it. Crop first if an avatar or wallpaper needs a specific ratio.
JPG cannot preserve transparency. Transparent pixels will be filled with the selected background color.
Width and height define a maximum bounding box. The image keeps its ratio; it is never stretched.

PNG is lossless: quality cannot reduce its size. The actual encoded file must fit the limit or export will fail.
The actual file size is checked. Quality may be reduced down to 10; if the limit still cannot be met, export fails without silently resizing.
